legal.title: Legal information
legal.subtitle: How we handle your order, your payment, and your information.
legal.identityBody: This store operates under the name {siteName}. For any question or complaint, the fastest way to reach us is WhatsApp (see below).
legal.ordersBody: No online payment gateway is used: payment is made to the mobile money account shown at checkout, proof of payment (a screenshot) is submitted with the order form, and a team member confirms the order manually. No card details are ever collected or stored by this site.
legal.privacyBody: At checkout, only your name, phone number, city, and payment proof are collected — solely to process the order and contact you about it. This site does not use any third-party analytics or advertising tools.
legal.returnsBody: A return or refund is only accepted for a defective, damaged, or incorrect product — not for a simple change of mind. The issue must be reported within 48 hours of receiving the order, with a photo or video of the item sent via WhatsApp. Once the return is approved, the refund is sent back to the same mobile money account used for payment.

help.title: Help and user guide
help.hint: Everyday tasks, step by step, and what needs support.
help.contactHint: For these requests the SOLAL team steps in. A pre-filled message saves you retyping your details.
help.noContact: Support contact details have not been set yet. Contact SOLAL directly.

addProduct.title: Add a product
addProduct.when: To put a new item on sale in the shop and at the checkout.
steps: Open “Products” in the menu, then add a product.
Fill in the name, description, price and category.
Add at least one variant (size, colour, SKU, stock).
Add the photos, then save. The product is visible once it is active.
issues: A SKU that is already used is refused: each variant needs its own.
A product that has already been sold cannot be deleted: deactivate it instead.

manageCategories.title: Manage categories
manageCategories.when: To sort products and organise the shop.
steps: Open “Categories”.
Create a category by typing its name.
Change the order with the arrows: it is the order customers see.
Edit or delete a category with the icons on its row.
issues: A category that still holds products cannot be deleted: move its products first.

configureBoutique.title: Set up your boutique
configureBoutique.when: Do it once at the start, then adjust when your details change.
steps: Open “Settings”.
Fill in the boutique details, add the logo and the banner image.
Add your social links and testimonials.
Add your payment accounts (wallets): they are used for wallet sales at the checkout.
Set up the loyalty programme if you use it.
issues: With no wallet account, the checkout refuses a wallet payment: add one first.
Images must be PNG, JPEG or WebP.

createSeller.title: Create or remove a seller
createSeller.when: When someone needs to sell at the checkout without access to the rest of the administration.
steps: Open “Settings”, sellers section.
Add the seller with an e-mail and a password, then give them their access.
To remove a seller, first close their till (from “Till sessions”), then delete their account.
issues: A seller whose till is still open cannot be deleted.
If you reach the maximum number of sellers, contact support (see below).

twoFactor.title: Turn on two-factor authentication (2FA)
twoFactor.when: To protect your account with a temporary code on top of the password.
steps: Open “Settings”, security section.
Scan the QR code with an authenticator app.
Enter the 6-digit code to confirm.
issues: Keep your phone: if you lose it, only support can reset 2FA (see below).

processOrder.title: Process an online order
processOrder.when: When a customer places an order on the shop.
steps: Open “Orders”: orders to handle show a badge in the menu.
Check the order and the proof of payment, then click “Confirm” or “Reject” (pick a reason).
Once prepared, click “Ship”, then “Mark as delivered” on delivery.
Each step offers to send a WhatsApp message to the customer.
issues: An order already handled by someone else can no longer change status.
Not enough stock blocks the confirmation: update the stock first.

sellAtCheckout.title: Ring up a sale
sellAtCheckout.when: For each in-store sale. A till must be open.
steps: Open “Checkout”.
Tap products to add them to the cart (choose the size and colour).
Choose the payment: cash (enter the amount received) or wallet (choose the account that received the money).
Click “Charge”. The receipt can be sent to the customer by WhatsApp.
issues: “No open till”: open your till first.
“A price has changed”: check the new total before charging.
Sold-out item: remove it from the cart to continue.

openRegister.title: Open your till
openRegister.when: At the start of the day, before the first sale.
steps: Open “Checkout” (or “My till”).
Count the money in the drawer and enter it as the “Opening float”.
Click “Open the till”.
issues: Each person can only have one open till at a time in a boutique.
A till cannot be opened on a day the admin has already closed.

cashMovement.title: Cash in or cash out
cashMovement.when: When money enters or leaves the drawer outside a sale: change top-up, bank deposit, buying bags.
steps: Open “My till”, “Cash in and out” section.
Choose “Cash in” or “Cash out” and enter the amount.
Give the reason (required), then “Record”.
issues: A cash out higher than the expected cash is refused.

promoCode.title: Create a promo code
promoCode.when: To give shop customers a discount.
steps: Open “Promo codes” and create a code.
Choose the discount type (percentage or fixed amount).
Reserve it for one client or leave it general, add an expiry date or a maximum number of uses.
To stop it, deactivate it.
issues: If customers cannot enter a code at checkout, coupons are not enabled for your boutique: contact support (see below).

loyaltyCard.title: Loyalty card
loyaltyCard.when: To let customers earn points on each purchase.
steps: At the checkout, enter the customer's number under “Loyalty card” and click “Look up”.
If no card exists, click “Create card”.
The sale adds the points automatically; the customer can use their reward on a later sale.
issues: The programme must be switched on and configured by the admin in “Settings”.

manageClients.title: Manage clients
manageClients.when: To find a customer, fix their record or delete it.
steps: Open “Clients”.
Create or edit a record with the name and phone.
Open a client's record to see their history.
issues: A client who already has sales cannot be deleted.

closeRegister.title: Close your till
closeRegister.when: At the end of your shift, or when you leave the till.
steps: Open “My till”.
Count the cash in the drawer and enter it in “Counted cash”.
The system shows the difference from the expected cash.
If there is a difference, explain it in “Comment” (required), then “Close the till”.
issues: A closed till can no longer take sales.
Count carefully: the result is frozen when closing.

closeDay.title: Close the day
closeDay.when: Every evening, once all tills are closed. Boutique admin only.
steps: Open “Closures” and pick the day.
Check that every till is closed: otherwise close it from “Till sessions”.
Review the day's totals and difference.
Click “Close the day”: this is final.
issues: You cannot close while a till of that day (or an earlier one) is open.
A day is closed only once, and no till can be opened on it afterwards.

requestRefund.title: Request a refund
requestRefund.when: When a customer brings an item back.
steps: Open the sale (from “My sales”) and click “Request a refund”.
Choose the items and quantities returned.
Give the reason, then “Send the request”.
issues: The boutique admin must approve it; follow its status in “Refunds”.
Only one request can be pending per sale.

decideRefund.title: Approve or reject a refund
decideRefund.when: When a seller sends a request. Boutique admin only.
steps: Open “Refunds”: pending requests are shown first.
Read the request, then “Approve refund” or “Reject” (with a reason).
On approval, the items go back into stock.
issues: A cash refund leaves YOUR open till: open it before approving, with enough cash.
A request that has already been handled can no longer be changed.

cancelSale.title: Cancel or correct a sale
cancelSale.when: When a sale was entered by mistake. Boutique admin only.
steps: Open “Sales”, then the sale.
Correct it, or cancel it with a reason.
issues: If the customer returned an item, use a refund instead.
Every cancellation is recorded in “History”.

forgottenRegister.title: Till left open
forgottenRegister.when: When a till was not closed at the end of the day.
steps: After 24 h the till is closed automatically with the reason “closing forgotten”.
No count was made: the admin compares the cash with the expected amount (session page).
To close before 24 h, the admin opens “Till sessions” and closes the seller's till.
issues: Closing the day is blocked while a till is open.
An automatically closed till is flagged in the history.

license.title: Expired licence or suspended boutique
license.when: When a banner says the boutique is suspended or expired, or actions are blocked.
steps: Renewal and reactivation are done by support only.
Give the boutique name and your account e-mail.
Mention the message shown and the expiry date if you know it.

newBoutique.title: New boutique or boutique type
newBoutique.when: To create a boutique, rename it or delete it.
steps: These operations are done by support.
Give the name you want, the type of business and the manager's e-mail.

domain.title: Boutique domain name
domain.when: To make the boutique reachable at your own address.
steps: The domain is set up by support.
Give the domain you want and show that you own it.
Support will tell you the DNS settings to make at your domain provider.

sellerQuota.title: Maximum number of sellers
sellerQuota.when: When you can no longer create a seller because the limit is reached.
steps: The quota is changed by support.
Say how many sellers you need.

adminAccount.title: Admin account: add or remove
adminAccount.when: When a new manager needs admin access, or when access must be removed.
steps: Admin accounts are created and deleted by support.
Give the person's e-mail and the action you need.

lostTwoFactor.title: Lost two-factor authentication
lostTwoFactor.when: When you changed phone or removed the authenticator app and can no longer sign in.
steps: Only support can reset your 2FA.
Give your account e-mail, then you can set up a new one at your next sign-in.

appearance.title: Boutique theme and appearance
appearance.when: When you cannot see the theme, colour or layout settings.
steps: These settings are available only if support has granted you the right.
Ask for it to be switched on, saying what you want to change.
